verdict.rationale: Airbyte's built-in notification system can send notifications about important events to a webhook as well as email, which is a first-party outbound HTTP callback. The evidence does not show the event catalog, payload schema, or programmatic registration, so how far this supports event subscription is unproven. Missing for 10: documented event types and payload schema, API-based webhook registration/subscription management, signing/retry semantics, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Airbyte can send notifications to an email address, webhook, or both.
If you want Airbyte to notify you about important events, use its built-in notification system.
Airbyte Cloud can send notifications to an email or webhook.
